creator: Alexander Terp
description:
amterp, 2026-10-01: "forward back button". Clarified 2026-10-03: "my main use is on mouse going back and forth on pane focuses".

A focus history like a browser's: the mouse's back button returns to the pane that had focus before, forward goes again, across tabs. Today those buttons go to the program in the pane as buttons 8 and 9 (Sources/MusterRenderer/Renderer.swift). Back them with keymap actions (`focus_back` / `focus_forward`) so a chord and the CLI reach the same history, which lives in the core. Decide what a closed pane in the history does, and whether a pane whose program asked for mouse reporting still gets the buttons.
title: ↩️ Mouse back and forward walk the panes you were on
